thread:
rachel: Quick flag  we observed a small but consistent uptick in embedding failures during tail spikes. I have a tiny hotfix: model-embed v2.3.5-microfix. Need an express micro-cut (02:50-02:55 UTC) with a safety rollback plan.

samir: Can you paste the exact command + one-line release blurb? Also why do we want to skip canary this time?

rachel: Command: `/deploy pin model-embed:v2.3.5-microfix --no-canary --note \"hotfix: fix eviction race + backoff\"`

rachel: Reason to skip canary: the issue reproduces under tail burst batching patterns that are underrepresented at 10% traffic; staging shows the parity mismatch. Rolling staged 5/50/100 with tight monitors reduces risk but avoids masking.

ops_oncall: I'll own the rollback gate. Rollback triggers: embed_5xx_rate >1% sustained for 3m OR p95_latency > +180ms over baseline for 5m. Also watch host_mem_pressure and autoscaler churn.

kate: PM acked. I have the customer blurb ready once you confirm text.

rachel: Blurb: \"v2.3.5-microfix: resolves a kvcache eviction race that could cause intermittent embedding failures under bursty load. Hotfix applied.\"

infra: infra: quick preflight done: image signed, smoke on staging passed (0/200 errors).

deploybot: Deploybot: next deploy slot available at 02:52 UTC. To proceed run the pinned command. Confirmers required: @kate @ops_oncall.

kate: Approving expedited deploy for 02:52. Posting changelog after success.

samir: Quick preflight check: `http POST https://int-api/embed/smoke version=v2.3.5-microfix samples=150` -> returned 0/150 errors, p95=130ms (baseline 128ms).

rachel: Starting now at 02:52. @deploybot please execute pin. We'll do 5% -> 50% -> 100% with 90s watch windows.

deploybot: Started rollout at 02:52 UTC. Steps: 5% -> 50% -> 100%. Monitors attached: embed_5xx_rate, embed_error_rate, p95_latency, host_mem_pressure. Live: https://deploys.internal/1781239876

ops_oncall: 5% OK. No 5xx spike. p95 129ms.

samir: 50% step: slight blip in embed_error_rate on one host (0.9% instant), autoscaler cycled the host, back to baseline. No customer-facing errors.

ops_oncall: Holding 50% for extra 60s to observe.

rachel: Logs show transient eviction contention suppressed by backoff. 

deploybot: Proceeding to 100% at 02:54 UTC.

ops_oncall: Post-deploy 6m roll: embed_5xx_rate = 0.3%, p95_latency = 135ms (+7ms). host_mem_pressure normal. No rollback. Green. :white_check_mark:

kate: Published customer-facing note and internal release digest.

releasebot: Releasebot: changelog entry created: \"2026-04-02  v2.3.5-microfix: kvcache eviction race fix to reduce embedding failures under burst.\"

samir: Nice quick turnaround. Recommend we add a synthetic burst test that mimics tail batching to CI.

rachel: Agree — filing infra ticket to add synthetic tail-burst scenario. Assigning follow-up to @infra. Thanks all.
